report.clinical_summary: Patient with HIV diagnosed 5 years ago, currently on Tivicay and Descovy once daily with generally good adherence (occasional lapses when fatigued/down). Persistent symptoms include constant joint pain (dull ache), worsening peripheral neuropathy (burning/tingling in feet), fatigue, and sleep difficulties. Has lost weight. CD4 count 385 cells/uL (improved but not normal), viral load undetectable. No additional medications for pain/neuropathy. Functional impact: symptoms affecting ability to do things that used to be manageable. No recent regimen changes. Regular monitoring but no specific investigations yet.
